diagrams.title: **A2A between agents, MCP inside each
diagrams.caption: **A2A between agents, MCP inside each.** The two agents collaborate as peers; each uses its own MCP-connected tools to do its part.

diagrams.title: **Six reasons for a shared agent protocol
diagrams.caption: **Six reasons for a shared agent protocol.** Different frameworks, harder tasks, and organisational boundaries all point to the same need: one common way for agents to talk.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 440" aria-label="Six reasons A2A is needed, around a central A2A protocol: solve framework fragmentation, enable complex collaboration, act as a common language like HTTP, support cross-organisation workflows, preserve agent capabilities, and ensure vendor neutrality." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
      <circle cx="550" cy="220" r="96" class="proto" style="fill:#ECE5FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:4"></circle><text x="550" y="212" text-anchor="middle" class="tl" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:24px;font-weight:700">A2A</text><text x="550" y="240" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">agent-to-agent</text>
      <g>
        <rect x="40" y="30" width="330" height="100" rx="16" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="60" y="64" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">1 Framework fragmentation</text><text x="60" y="92" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK, Strands…</text><text x="60" y="114" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">one shared protocol for all</text>
        <rect x="730" y="30" width="330" height="100" rx="16" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="750" y="64" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">2 Complex collaboration</text><text x="750" y="92" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">flights + hotels + activities</text><text x="750" y="114" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">need specialists working together</text>
        <rect x="40" y="170" width="330" height="100" rx="16" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="60" y="204" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">3 A common language</text><text x="60" y="232" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">what HTTP did for the web,</text><text x="60" y="254" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">A2A does for agents</text>
        <rect x="730" y="170" width="330" height="100" rx="16" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="750" y="204" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">4 Cross-organisation work</text><text x="750" y="232" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">teams and companies collaborate;</text><text x="750" y="254" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">agents stay opaque</text>
        <rect x="40" y="310" width="330" height="100" rx="16" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="60" y="344" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">5 Preserve agent capabilities</text><text x="60" y="372" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">more than a single tool call:</text><text x="60" y="394" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">multi-step, open-ended goals</text>
        <rect x="730" y="310" width="330" height="100" rx="16" class="bx2" style="fill:#F8F9FC;stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:2"></rect><text x="750" y="344" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">6 Vendor neutrality</text><text x="750" y="372" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">hosted by the Linux Foundation,</text><text x="750" y="394" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">community governed</text>
      </g>
      <path d="M370 80 Q440 110 470 160 M730 80 Q660 110 630 160 M370 220 H454 M730 220 H646 M370 360 Q440 330 470 280 M730 360 Q660 330 630 280" class="ln-proto" style="stroke:#6C43CC;stroke-width:3;fill:none"></path>
    </svg>

diagrams.title: **One request, four experts, four silos
diagrams.caption: **One request, four experts, four silos.** Each agent is built differently, uses different data formats and runs on different systems, so without a shared protocol they can't even discover each other.
diagrams.svg:

diagrams.title: **In
diagrams.caption: **In: a message made of parts. Out: artifacts made of parts.** In between, a task tracks the work and its status.
diagrams.svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 330" aria-label="The A2A data model. A client sends a message, a single turn of interaction made of parts: text, JSON, file or other data. The remote agent may create a task that tracks work over time; the client can call GetTask to retrieve status and results. The task produces artifacts, output containers that also hold parts: text, JSON, file or multimodal output." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker><marker id="ah-data" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="ah-data" d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z"></path></marker></defs>

diagrams.title: **Four execution modes
diagrams.caption: **Four execution modes.** From "wait right here" to "call me when it's done".
diagrams.svg:

Streaming: continuous data flow. Push notifications: alert the other agent when specific events occur." style="max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
        <rect x="16" y="20" width="252" height="160" rx="16" class="data" style="fill:#E1E9FC;stroke:#2958C4;stroke-width:2.5"></rect><text x="142" y="60" text-anchor="middle" class="t" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#19203F;font-size:19px;font-weight:700">Synchronous</text><text x="142" y="100" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">wait for an</text><text x="142" y="122" text-anchor="middle" class="ts" style="font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;fill:#586082;font-size:16px;font-weight:400">immediate response</text>

diagrams.title: **Take a token, check back later
diagrams.caption: **Take a token, check back later.** Agent A isn't stuck waiting; it polls with the task ID until the status reaches a final state.

diagrams.title: **"Don't call us, we'll call you
diagrams.caption: **"Don't call us, we'll call you."** No open connection, no polling: the server rings the client's doorbell when it matters.
